Test Scenario: Verify Payment Processing sidebar expands and Miscellaneous Charges submenu is accessible
Pre-Requisites: User logged in with Operations Manager role
Steps: 1. Click "Payment Processing" in sidebar
Expected result: Submenu expands showing Payables, Approval, History, Miscellaneous Charges; clicking Miscellaneous Charges navigates to /payment-processing/miscellaneous-charges

Test Scenario: Verify Miscellaneous Charges page loads with correct heading
Steps: 1. Navigate to the page
Expected result: Heading "Miscellaneous Charges" is displayed with "Add Miscellaneous Charge" button

Test Scenario: Verify grid displays expected columns
Steps: 1. Observe the data grid columns
Expected result: Columns shown: Txn Date, Txn ID, Agent, Amount, Payment Batch, Payment Date (plus checkbox selection column)

Test Scenario: Verify empty grid shows No Records Found and 0 record footer
Steps: 1. Observe grid body with no data
Expected result: Grid shows "No Records Found", status "No data available", footer "Showing all 0 records"

Test Scenario: Verify search box placeholder and helper text
Steps: 1. Observe the search box
Expected result: Placeholder "Search by agent, amount, date, txn id, status..." and helper text about filtering the data grid are displayed

Test Scenario: Verify Agent filter dropdown lists All Agents and available agents
Steps: 1. Open the Agent filter
Expected result: Filter shows "All Agents" plus the list of agents available; selecting an agent filters the grid to that agent's charges

Test Scenario: Verify Status filter dropdown lists All Status and statuses
Steps: 1. Open the Status filter
Expected result: Filter shows "All Status" plus statuses; selecting a status filters the grid accordingly

Test Scenario: Verify search filters grid by transaction ID, agent, amount or date
Steps: 1. Type a known transaction ID in search; 2. Observe results
Expected result: Grid rows narrow to those matching the search text (agent, amount, date, txn id, status)

Test Scenario: Verify Add Miscellaneous Charge modal opens
Steps: 1. Click "Add Miscellaneous Charge"
Expected result: Modal opens with heading "Add Miscellaneous Charge", subtitle "Enter the details for the new miscellaneous charge.", Close (X) button, date/agent/amount/description fields and Cancel + Save buttons

Test Scenario: Verify Transaction Date defaults to today's date
Steps: 1. Open Add Miscellaneous Charge modal; 2. Observe Transaction Date
Expected result: Transaction Date field is pre-filled with today's date (date picker), marked required

Test Scenario: Verify Save is disabled when required fields are empty
Steps: 1. Open Add modal; 2. Observe Save button with empty Agent, Amount, Description
Expected result: Save button is disabled until Agent, Amount and Description are all filled

Test Scenario: Verify Agent field is required and searchable
Steps: 1. Leave Agent empty and attempt save; 2. Open Agent dropdown and type a code
Expected result: Save blocked while Agent empty; dropdown searchable by code/name (options as "code - name")

Test Scenario: Verify Amount field is required and numeric
Steps: 1. Leave Amount empty or enter non-numeric text; 2. Attempt save
Expected result: Save blocked while Amount empty/non-numeric; numeric amount accepted and enables Save

Test Scenario: Verify Description field is required
Steps: 1. Leave Description empty; 2. Attempt save
Expected result: Save blocked while Description empty; entering text enables Save

Test Scenario: Verify Save button becomes enabled when all required fields are filled
Steps: 1. Select an agent; 2. Enter amount 250; 3. Enter description; 4. Observe Save
Expected result: Save button becomes enabled after Agent, Amount and Description are valid

Test Scenario: Verify Close (X) button closes the modal without saving
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal with empty fields
Steps: 1. Open Add modal; 2. Click Close (X)
Expected result: Modal closes; no record created; page remains on Miscellaneous Charges

Test Scenario: Verify Cancel with unsaved changes shows confirmation dialog
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal and enters data
Steps: 1. Open Add modal; 2. Fill agent/amount/description; 3. Click Cancel
Expected result: Cancel Changes dialog appears: "Are you sure you want to cancel? All unsaved changes will be lost." with Cancel and Keep Editing options

Test Scenario: Verify Keep Editing returns to the modal preserving entered values
Pre-Requisites: User has unsaved changes in Add modal
Steps: 1. Fill modal fields; 2. Cancel; 3. Click "Keep Editing"
Expected result: Modal stays open with entered values intact; no data lost

Test Scenario: Verify confirming Cancel discards changes and closes modal
Pre-Requisites: User has unsaved changes in Add modal
Steps: 1. Fill modal fields; 2. Cancel; 3. Click "Cancel" in confirmation
Expected result: Modal closes; entered values discarded; no record created

Test Scenario: Verify a valid Miscellaneous Charge saves and appears in the grid
Steps: 1. Open Add modal; 2. Select agent (e.g. 90058 - TestAgent0058); 3. Enter amount; 4. Enter description; 5. Save
Expected result: Modal closes; charge is saved and appears in the grid with Txn Date, Txn ID, Agent, Amount populated; Save uses the entered data

Test Scenario: Verify saving a charge generates a Transaction ID for the row
Steps: 1. After saving a charge observe its grid row
Expected result: Txn ID column is populated for the saved row (unique identifier per transaction)

Test Scenario: Verify Transaction Date can be changed to a past or future date
Steps: 1. Change Transaction Date via the date picker to a valid date
Expected result: Transaction Date field accepts a valid manually-selected date; save uses the selected date

Test Scenario: Verify modal closes after successful save
Pre-Requisites: User on Add modal with valid data
Steps: 1. Fill valid data; 2. Save
Expected result: Modal closes automatically after successful save; grid refreshes showing the new record

Test Scenario: Verify Process button is disabled when no rows are selected
Steps: 1. Observe Process button without selecting any row
Expected result: Process button is disabled when no grid rows are checked

Test Scenario: Verify Cancel (batch) button is disabled when no rows are selected
Steps: 1. Observe batch Cancel button without selecting any row
Expected result: Batch Cancel button is disabled when no grid rows are checked

Test Scenario: Verify Process button enables after selecting a charge row
Pre-Requisites: At least one draft charge exists
Steps: 1. Check the checkbox of a charge row; 2. Observe Process
Expected result: Process button becomes enabled once at least one row is selected

Test Scenario: Verify batch Cancel enables after selecting a charge row
Pre-Requisites: At least one draft charge exists
Steps: 1. Check the checkbox of a charge row; 2. Observe Cancel
Expected result: Batch Cancel button becomes enabled once a row is selected

Test Scenario: Verify select-all checkbox selects all grid rows
Steps: 1. Tick the header select-all checkbox
Expected result: All charge rows become selected; batch buttons enabled

Test Scenario: Verify processing a selected charge populates Payment Batch and Payment Date
Steps: 1. Select a charge; 2. Click Process
Expected result: Charge transitions to processed state; Payment Batch and Payment Date columns populate for the processed row

Test Scenario: Verify batch Cancel cancels selected charges
Pre-Requisites: At least one selected draft charge
Steps: 1. Select charge(s); 2. Click batch Cancel; 3. Confirm
Expected result: Selected charges are cancelled/removed from the active list; grid reflects the cancelled state

Test Scenario: Verify Process requires confirmation for processed charges
Pre-Requisites: User clicks Process on a selected row
Steps: 1. Select a charge; 2. Click Process
Expected result: Confirmation dialog appears before processing (unsaved/batch confirmation) - user confirms or aborts

Test Scenario: Verify processing multiple selected charges in one batch
Steps: 1. Select 2+ charges; 2. Click Process
Expected result: All selected charges processed in the batch; each row gets Payment Batch / Payment Date

Test Scenario: Verify grid columns can be toggled via Columns button
Steps: 1. Click Toggle columns; 2. Uncheck a column; 3. Recheck
Expected result: Selected column hides and reappears; toolbar is functional when data present

Test Scenario: Verify Export grid data to Excel exports charge records
Steps: 1. Click Export grid data to Excel
Expected result: Excel file download triggered containing the charge grid data

Test Scenario: Verify Refresh grid data reloads the grid from server
Steps: 1. Click Refresh grid data
Expected result: Grid reloads; data refreshes without page navigation; loading indicator appears then resolves

Test Scenario: Verify Amount column formats values as currency
Pre-Requisites: At least one charge with amount exists
Steps: 1. Observe Amount column in grid rows
Expected result: Amount values displayed in currency format (e.g. $250.00) matching entered amount

Test Scenario: Verify Txn Date and Payment Date columns display dates in MM/DD/YYYY format
Pre-Requisites: At least one processed charge exists
Steps: 1. Observe Txn Date and Payment Date values
Expected result: Dates rendered in MM/DD/YYYY format (e.g. 09/08/2026)

Test Scenario: Verify processed charge reflects selected agent in grid
Pre-Requisites: One processed charge for a known agent
Steps: 1. Process a charge for test agent; 2. Observe grid Agent column
Expected result: Grid Agent column shows the selected agent's name (code - name)

Test Scenario: Verify Agent filter narrows grid to one agent's charges
Pre-Requisites: Charges for two different agents exist
Steps: 1. Open Agent filter; 2. Select agent A
Expected result: Grid shows only charges for agent A; charges for agent B hidden

Test Scenario: Verify Status filter narrows grid to a status
Steps: 1. Open Status filter; 2. Select a status
Expected result: Grid shows only charges with the selected status

Test Scenario: Verify search by amount value filters correctly
Steps: 1. Type a charge amount in the search box; 2. Observe results
Expected result: Grid rows narrow to charges whose amount matches the search text

Test Scenario: Verify miscellaneous charges flow integrates into Approval and History
Pre-Requisites: At least one processed charge exists
Steps: 1. Process a charge; 2. Navigate to Approval; 3. Navigate to History
Expected result: Processed charge is visible in Approval (pending) and History (completed) payment-processing views; lifecycle consistent with Payment Batch / Payment Date

Test Scenario: Verify no data state disables select-all and batch actions
Steps: 1. Observe grid and batch buttons with empty data
Expected result: Select-all checkbox disabled; Cancel and Process batch buttons disabled; "No Records Found" shown

Test Scenario: Verify unchecking a previously selected row disables batch buttons
Pre-Requisites: Charges exist, one row selected then deselected
Steps: 1. Select a row; 2. Uncheck it; 3. Observe batch buttons
Expected result: Process and Cancel buttons revert to disabled when no rows remain selected

Test Scenario: Verify Amount exactly 0 keeps Save disabled
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal; agent + description filled
Steps: 1. Open Add modal; 2. Fill agent and description; 3. Enter amount 0; 4. Observe Save
Expected result: Save remains disabled for amount 0 - only positive amounts are accepted

Test Scenario: Verify negative Amount keeps Save disabled
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal; agent + description filled
Steps: 1. Fill agent and description; 2. Enter amount -50; 3. Observe Save
Expected result: Save remains disabled for negative amounts

Test Scenario: Verify non-numeric Amount keeps Save disabled with no inline error
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal; agent + description filled
Steps: 1. Fill agent and description; 2. Enter amount "abc"; 3. Blur the field; 4. Observe
Expected result: Save stays disabled; no per-field error text is displayed - invalid input fails silently

Test Scenario: Verify Amount as 0.00 keeps Save disabled
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal; agent + description filled
Steps: 1. Fill agent and description; 2. Enter amount 0.00; 3. Observe Save
Expected result: Save remains disabled - zero-valued amounts not accepted

Test Scenario: Verify malformed Amount 1.2.3 keeps Save disabled
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal; agent + description filled
Steps: 1. Fill agent and description; 2. Enter amount 1.2.3; 3. Blur; 4. Observe
Expected result: Save stays disabled for multiple-decimal malformed amounts

Test Scenario: Verify Amount with leading zeros/spaces is accepted
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal; agent + description filled
Steps: 1. Fill agent and description; 2. Enter amount 00125 / " 25 "; 3. Observe Save
Expected result: Save enables - leading zeros and surrounding spaces are tolerated by the client

Test Scenario: Verify Amount with 3+ decimals is accepted client-side
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal; agent + description filled
Steps: 1. Fill agent and description; 2. Enter 25.567; 3. Observe Save
Expected result: Save enables client-side; backend precision policy to be confirmed during integration (may reject on save)

Test Scenario: Verify search with no matching results shows empty state
Steps: 1. Type a non-existent txn id/agent in search; 2. Observe grid
Expected result: Grid shows the No Records Found / empty state when no row matches

Test Scenario: Verify Add save failure shows error toast and keeps data
Steps: 1. Fill valid Add modal data; 2. Trigger save failure; 3. Observe
Expected result: Error toast shown; modal stays open with entered values preserved for retry

Test Scenario: Verify batch Process failure shows toast and rows remain unprocessed
Steps: 1. Select charge rows; 2. Click Process with backend failure; 3. Observe
Expected result: Error toast shown; rows remain selected/unchanged; no partial batch applied

Test Scenario: Verify Amount field accepts large values within no client max
Pre-Requisites: User opens Add modal; agent + description filled
Steps: 1. Fill agent and description; 2. Enter 999999999999; 3. Observe Save
Expected result: Save enables - no client-side length cap on amount; backend limits verified in integration

Test Scenario: Verify Status column is present in the misc charges grid
Pre-Requisites: At least one charge exists in grid
Steps: 1. Observe grid header columns
Expected result: Grid shows Status column (in addition to Txn Date, Txn ID, Agent, Amount, Payment Batch, Payment Date) reflecting the charge lifecycle

Test Scenario: Verify saved misc charge gets a dynamic TX-prefixed Transaction ID
Pre-Requisites: One charge saved via Add modal
Steps: 1. Save a misc charge; 2. Capture the grid row Txn ID; 3. Assert its format
Expected result: Row Txn ID is auto-generated and unique per record; matches pattern TX- + 6 alphanumeric chars (regex ^TX-[A-Z0-9]{6}$); value is dynamic and must not be hard-coded

Test Scenario: Verify processing a charge removes it from the Misc Charges grid
Pre-Requisites: At least one unprocessed charge exists
Steps: 1. Select charge row; 2. Click Process; 3. Return to Misc Charges grid
Expected result: Processed record no longer listed in Misc Charges grid; only pending/unprocessed charges remain

Test Scenario: Verify processed misc charge appears in Payables grid
Steps: 1. Navigate to Payables (Pending Payments); 2. Locate the processed charge
Expected result: Record appears in Payables with dynamic Txn ID matching ^TX-[A-Z0-9]{6}$ (capture it), Paid To Agent (agent first+last name), Amount in currency, Type MISCELLANEOUS_CHARGE

Test Scenario: Verify misc charge amount displays negative in parentheses in Payables
Pre-Requisites: Processed misc charge with a debit amount
Steps: 1. Process a misc charge of 100; 2. Open Payables; 3. Locate the row
Expected result: Amount rendered as (.00) - negative/debit values wrapped in parentheses, 2-decimal currency

Test Scenario: Verify misc charge Type column shows MISCELLANEOUS_CHARGE in Payables
Pre-Requisites: Processed misc charge present in Payables
Steps: 1. Open Payables; 2. Locate the misc charge row; 3. Observe Type column
Expected result: Type shows MISCELLANEOUS_CHARGE, distinct from COMMISSION / MMP statement rows
